Resolutions of 2026

24 resolutions, 59% unanimous. Ukraine and fragmentation.

  • 2817 (2026) Condemning attacks by the Islamic Republic of Iran against Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Jordan
  • 2818 (2026) Extension of the mandate of the UN Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA) until 17 June 2026
  • 2819 (2026) Extension of the authorizations provided by and the measures imposed by Security Council resolution 2146 (2014) and extension of the mandate of the Panel of Experts concerning Libya until 15 Aug. 2027
  • 2820 (2026) Resolution 2820
  • 2821 (2026) Renewal of sanctions imposed by Security Council resolution 2428 (2018) until 31 May 2027 and extension of the mandate of the Panel of Experts on South Sudan until 1 July 2027
  • 2822 (2026) Extension of the mandate of the UN Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA) until 17 June 2027
  • 2823 (2026) Safety and security of peacekeepers
  • 2824 (2026) Extension of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force (UNDOF) until 31 Dec. 2026
